newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UK's HMV to open S$10 mln Singapore store.
newsitem.headline: UK's HMV to open S$10 mln Singapore store.

text.p: UK music retailer His Master's Voice (HMV), a unit of EMI Plc, said on Thursday it was opening a Singapore $10 million store in Singapore in the first half of 1997.

The S$10 million will be spent on renovation, fittings and stocks prior to the opening of the 25,000 sq feet store, Philip Kung, HMV's managing director for the Chinese Asia region, told reporters at a briefing.

The Singapore outlet will be HMV's first in Southeast Asia and will be located on three floors of a new shopping cum office complex in the heart of Singapore's Orchard Road shopping belt. It will be the biggest music outlet in Singapore and could become the company's flagship store for the Southeast Asian region, Kung said.
He said HMV was looking at opening more outlets in Singapore.
HMV has about 250 stores worldwide, including 20 in Japan and four in Hong Kong.
